item.title: Johnson Street shelter under deconstruction, city looking at what comes next
item.description: The Johnson Street shelter closed roughly six months ago, and the city is currently in the process of deconstructing the property with plans to sell it in the future for redevelopment.

item.title: Storm cleanup and restoration underway in Lincoln County
item.description: Flying high above Lincoln County paints a clear picture of just how much damage was done by extreme weather events in December, and the long road to recovery still ahead.

item.title: Missoula Sentinel tops Hellgate in clash of top Western AA teams; Knights girls hold off Spartans
item.description: Missoula Hellgate hosts crosstown rival Sentinel on Tuesday evening for the first meeting between the schools this season.
